answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. What survives to the mesa is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The echo lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the summit is where a second reviewer recomputes them. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, weighted by independent path length, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
